# intenter menu

What this project allows, and what you can do about it

One screen for the agent session: what currently runs in this project
without a prompt, and every action you can take, each with an example.
This is the command `/intenter` runs in Claude Code, and it is a normal
terminal command too.

It always exits 0. A command injected into an agent skill aborts the whole
invocation when it fails, so an unreachable daemon has to be something the
menu says rather than something it returns.

## Usage

```text
intenter menu [flags]
```

## Examples

```console
intenter menu
intenter menu --project ~/src/app
intenter menu --json
```

## Options

| Flag | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `--all` | — | show every project |
| `--project` `<string>` | — | show another project directory |

## Options inherited from parent commands

| Flag | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `--config` `<string>` | — | override the configuration file path |
| `--data-dir` `<string>` | — | override the Intenter data directory |
| `--json` | — | machine-readable JSON output |
| `-v`, `--verbose` | — | verbose output |
